Elf the Musical TYA

December 4 - 20, 2026

Based on the beloved holiday film, Elf The Musical TYA follows Buddy, a human raised as an elf at the North Pole, as he journeys to New York City to find his family and discover where he truly belongs. Filled with laughter, heart, and plenty of Christmas cheer, this modern holiday classic is a joyful celebration for the whole family.

Directed by Holly Barkdoll

ELF-THE MUSICAL TYA
Is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI).
All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI.
